assays.assay_name: Alcohol Deprivation Effect (ADE) — home-cage voluntary alcohol drinking
assays.assay_description: Long-term voluntary alcohol consumption with repeated deprivation phases in home cages with continuous access to water and 5/10/20% ethanol solutions. Total ethanol intake (g/kg/day) and water intake (ml/kg/day) measured daily at ~9 a.m. for 1 week post-relapse plus 3 weeks follow-up, across three drug-administration schemes (sub-chronic psilocybin 1 mg/kg; high-dose psilocybin 2.5/10 mg/kg or LSD 0.08/0.32 mg/kg twice 7 days apart; microdose psilocybin 0.1 mg/kg 8x over 4 weeks).

setup_habituation.evidence: Animals were tested in their own home cages; the home cage was the testing apparatus throughout long-term alcohol drinking.

setup_restrain.evidence: animals were freely moving in their home cages during recording

food_restriction.evidence: Standard laboratory rat food and water were provided ad libitum throughout the experimental period.

water_restriction.evidence: Standard laboratory rat food and water were provided ad libitum throughout the experimental period.

time_to_assay.evidence: Exp1: bottles reintroduced after the second injection (at ~9 a.m.); Exp2: second injection ~15 h before ADE; Exp3: bottles reintroduced 16 h after the last application.

sample_size.evidence: Ninety-one 2-month-old male and female Wistar rats; rats were divided into three groups (n = 8–10)

outcomes.summary: Sub-chronic psilocybin (1 mg/kg, 5 doses over 3 days) produced a short-lasting reduction of the ADE relative to vehicle. High-dose psilocybin (2.5 or 10 mg/kg, twice 7 days apart) and LSD (0.08 or 0.32 mg/kg, twice 7 days apart), as well as 4-week microdosing of psilocybin (0.1 mg/kg, 8 doses), had no effect on the ADE. Water intake and locomotion were unaffected. Sex was not a significant covariate.
outcomes.statistics: Exp1: factor day F(5,165)=2.59, p<0.027; treatment × day F(5,165)=3.89, p<0.002; sex covariate F(1,33)=0.84, p<0.36; water F(5,165)=0.42, p=0.83. Exp2: psilocybin factor day F(5,275)=14.42, p<0.0001; LSD F(5,250)=11.18, p<0.0001 (no treatment effect). Exp3: factor day F(5,165)=5.64, p<0.0001 (no treatment effect).
outcomes.evidence: psilocybin treatment reduced the expression of ADE ... Alcohol intake was significantly reduced in psilocybin-treated rats ... However, there was no difference of either psilocybin or LSD treatment for the tested doses on ADE ... no difference of psilocybin treatment compared to vehicle on ADE was observed

assays.assay_description: Continuous home-cage locomotor activity recorded by an infrared sensor (Mouse-E-Motion) placed 30 cm above each cage, sampling every second whether the rat had moved ≥1.5 cm, analyzed in 30-min blocks across baseline, drug administration, ADE and follow-up.

setup_habituation.evidence: Recording occurred in the animal's home cage with no separate apparatus habituation needed.

setup_restrain.evidence: the rat could be detected at any position inside the cage

food_restriction.evidence: Standard laboratory rat food and water were provided ad libitum throughout the experimental period.

water_restriction.evidence: Standard laboratory rat food and water were provided ad libitum throughout the experimental period.

time_to_assay.evidence: Locomotor activity monitored continuously; in Exp1 a 2 h reduction was observed immediately after psilocybin injection in males; recordings also span days/weeks post-dose.

sample_size.evidence: n = 8–10 per treatment condition and sex

outcomes.summary: No overall difference in home-cage locomotor activity between psilocybin/LSD and vehicle groups. A transient 2-h reduction in activity was observed after acute 1 mg/kg psilocybin injection in male rats only, not in females. No locomotor effects were observed in the high-dose or microdosing experiments.
outcomes.statistics: Treatment group × day interaction: F(8,152)=0.67, p=0.71 (Experiment 1).
outcomes.evidence: a repeated measurement ANOVA revealed no significant difference in activity of rats treated with psilocybin ... [F(8,152) = 0.67, p = 0.71] ... locomotor activity was reduced for 2 h following psilocybin administration exclusively in males.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Single measure: home-cage locomotor activity counts.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Home-cage locomotor activity measurements for the ADE experiment were analyzed in 30 min blocks over the entire experiment; transient 2 h post-injection reduction observed.

B4_ethological.evidence: Movement counts (motion vs no motion); locomotion is not a scored ethological act per rubric.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Infrared beam/motion detection processed in Excel; no ML/pose estimation.

E1_environment_type.evidence: home cage locomotor activity was monitored ... A Mouse-E-Motion device was placed above each cage

E8_food_water.evidence: Food and water provided ad libitum in the home cage during recording.

D1_continuity.evidence: The device was sampling every second, whether the rat was moving or not ... over the entire experiment

D2_session_duration.evidence: Continuous home-cage monitoring across days/weeks; single recording sessions span >6 h.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Locomotor activity monitored across baseline week, deprivation/drug period, ADE week and 3 weeks follow-up.

D4_baseline.evidence: Food and water intake as well as locomotion was measured starting 3 days before the first injection.

D5_followup.evidence: Activity monitored for three weeks after ADE.

D6_circadian.evidence: Continuous sampling every second across full days/nights spans >=6 h.

judge_notes: Collapsed all three drug-administration experiments (sub-chronic psilocybin, high-dose psilocybin/LSD, microdose psilocybin) into a single ADE assay entry per rubric rule that the same behavioural paradigm under different drug/dose/schedule conditions is one assay.
Dropped 'Water consumption' as a separate assay (gptoss); water intake is one of the measures within the home-cage drinking ADE paradigm, not a distinct behavioural paradigm.

Kept 'Home-cage locomotor activity' as a separate assay because it uses a different measurement system (infrared motion sensor) and reports independent locomotor outcomes including within-session temporal dynamics (30-min bins, 2-h post-injection effect).
B2 for ADE scored 0: ANCOVA day factor is between-session (day-to-day), not within-session temporal dynamics.
Single Psilocybin dosing entry consolidates all three psilocybin schedules (acute/repeated/microdose) using schedule='multiple'.
Group housing scored 'no' because the paper explicitly states animals were housed individually.
